name: Movies
short_desc: Private movie and series watch queue.
description: Private test release: starts with Batman Begins (2005). Your queue, history and notes stay in the app data folder.
author: Humanity Labs

form_fields.label: Where-to-watch country
form_fields.hint: Two-letter country code (e.g. TH, US) for JustWatch streaming availability. Empty hides it and makes no lookups.

form_fields.label: Watch-date timezone
form_fields.hint: IANA timezone used for 'watched today' dates, e.g. Asia/Bangkok.

form_fields.label: Agent request admission mode
form_fields.hint: Keep disabled unless explicitly opting into live Agent Service runs (value: live).

form_fields.label: Optional Agent Service origin
form_fields.hint: Required together with live admission; requests otherwise stay local and the add sheet adds titles directly.

form_fields.label: Agent display name
form_fields.hint: Shown on the add sheet when agent requests are live, e.g. Archimedes.

form_fields.label: Trusted Wizard browser origin
form_fields.hint: Exact origin(s), comma separated, allowed to write from another host; no public direct backend.
